rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Garmin CN MCP Server enables AI assistants to interact with the Garmin Connect platform for Chinese users. Built with Python 3.13 and FastMCP, it authenticates with the Garmin CN API using email/password credentials and securely stores OAuth tokens for subsequent sessions. The implementation handles MFA authentication when required and provides a bridge to Garmin's health and fitness data. This server is particularly valuable for applications requiring access to fitness tracking, health metrics, and activity data from Garmin devices through the Chinese version of Garmin Connect.
